purpose: Internal map from each external-audit finding to a locally named regression test. It is not an independent or external retest result.

entries.finding: API-built transactions signed without returned-intent verification

test.name: rejects a returned transaction with a moved quote price

entries.finding: Simultaneous portfolio fills can exceed gross exposure

test.name: blocks portfolio quoting against every resting pair's simultaneous-fill exposure
requires aggregate collateral and three gas ceilings for Live, one for Paper

entries.finding: Removed members keep trading; no kill switch

test.name: stops a tenant as soon as a refreshed membership check is revoked
stops Paper by cancelling its scratch ledger without signing
runs urgent cancellation work before queued normal mutations

entries.finding: Deselected markets disappear from risk and flatten

test.name: keeps deselected positions inside the account-wide gross exposure gate

entries.finding: Hedge account is outside risk gates

test.name: fails closed when the dedicated hedge account nears margin or liquidation limits

entries.finding: Lagging index can quote one tick inside adverse touch

test.name: rejects a thin book that diverges from the protocol index
caps unconsumed sign-in challenges per wallet

entries.finding: One illiquid market blocks all flattening

test.name: automatically flattens both dedicated accounts before the gross limit

entries.finding: Browser signs host-built owner transactions unchecked

test.name: rejects an added SUI transfer
atomically re-encrypts stored agents under a new key and bound context
preserves Fastify 400 and rate-limit 429 statuses
creates a verified SQLite online backup without stopping the source database

entries.finding: Builder registration trusts API transaction and ID

test.name: pins the exact builder-registration command before wallet signing
deduplicates concurrent flatten requests
sums fake daily market stats once per taker-side market volume
does not coerce user strings that look like legacy bigint values

entries.finding: No Origin check; variable-time token compare

test.name: keeps the transport, embedding, and content restrictions enabled
enforces documented per-tenant retention without crossing tenants
marks signed position inventory from current index price
operator_can_add_and_remove_member

entries.finding: Missing risk inputs default to infinity

test.name: fails closed with typed 503 when an account read rejects or never resolves

entries.finding: Trial watchdog misleading; endpoint fixed at boot

test.name: re-probes endpoints after startup and adopts a recovered preferred endpoint
